ideas.title: User Authentication System
acceptanceCriteria: Users can securely log in to the platform
Authentication system is integrated with the application
ideas.description: Build a comprehensive authentication system to allow users to access the platform securely.

ideas.title: Implement User Login Functionality
acceptanceCriteria: Users can enter email and password on login page
System validates credentials against user database
Successful login redirects user to dashboard
Failed login shows appropriate error message
ideas.description: Enable users to securely log into the platform using their email and password credentials.

ideas.title: Implement Password Reset Flow
acceptanceCriteria: Users can request password reset from login page
Reset email is sent to user's registered email address
Reset link is valid for 24 hours
Users can set a new password through reset link
User is notified when password is successfully changed
ideas.description: Allow users to securely reset their password if they forget it.
